# Changelog

## 1.1.0
- Formulário com e-mail is a plain R$ 200 add-on on any tier: it no longer moves a site up to Site com
  recursos and is never the included feature. Site institucional + formulário = R$ 1.400;
  Página única + agendamento stays R$ 2.500.
- Site com recursos' description and includes no longer list the form.

## 1.0.0
- The catalogue (tiers with pages and includes, add-ons, rules, launch flag) and quote.mjs.
